book_title: Stumbled & Standing: from Diagnosis to Acceptance- A Woman's Journey with Multiple Sclerosis
author: River Urke
book_description: Stumbled & from Diagnosis to Acceptance- A Woman's Journey with Multiple Sclerosis is a collection of poetry and essays of struggles and achievements living with the progression of MS. They are the writings she wrote while trying to understand and cope with the changes and gifts in her life. River's story is compelling and alive with her positive attitude to rejuvenate and keep moving forward. A book about life and the tools we find to endure. Thumbs up for the story of one woman's journey through MS. River Urke has compiled a wonderful collection that will touch the hearts of all who read.~ Natasha HeadShow more
